#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    int n;
    string s;
    cin >> n >> s;
    
    int len = 0;
    int max_len = 0;
    int count = 0;
    bool inside = false;

    for (char c : s) {
        if (c == '_') {
            if (len > 0) {
                if (inside) count++;
                else max_len = max(max_len, len);
            }
            len = 0;
        } else if (c == '(') {
            if (len > 0) max_len = max(max_len, len);
            len = 0;
            inside = true;
        } else if (c == ')') {
            if (len > 0) count++;
            len = 0;
            inside = false;
        } else {
            len++;
        }
    }
    if (len > 0) max_len = max(max_len, len);

    cout << max_len << " " << count << endl;
    return 0;
}
